subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Accessibility in CI Pipelines
description: One-minute skill: Accessibility in CI Pipelines.

hook.text: A developer adds a button without a label. The CI pipeline doesn't check accessibility. It ships to production.

buildup.text: Integrating automated accessibility checks into CI catches regressions before code reaches users.

discovery.text: Tools like axe-core run in CI, fail builds on critical violations, and generate reports per pull request.

twist.text: CI catches only automated issues. Schedule periodic manual audits alongside continuous automated checks.

climax.text: Adding axe-core to CI catches eight new violations in a single sprint, all fixed before deployment.

punchline.text: Accessibility in CI prevents regressions. Manual audits prevent blind spots.

quiz.question: What does accessibility testing in CI prevent?
options: Regressions that introduce new violations in each code change
